svg.aria-label: Star schema of the Power BI model: three facts in the middle, Daily Price (1,018 rows), Price Change (127) and Price Gap (824), and three dimensions around them: Product (360) and Store (11) above, Date (808) below. Every column is listed with its type and its PK and FK marks; each of the 8 relationships is one line, one dimension row to many fact rows. Price Gap has no Date line: it holds each listing's latest price only.
svg.title: Competitor price tracker star schema

g.text: PK primary key · FK foreign key · crow's foot = many, bar = one · blue fact, green dimension
